name: Finance
description: Manual and connected accounts, transactions, and budgets.

screens.label: Budget
screens.description: Choose one fixed working currency through reviewed setup; existing assignment amounts require acknowledgement and stay unchanged. Only accounts and posted activity in that currency fund the budget. Tracking accounts and pending entries are excluded. Past manual balances use the opening ledger; connected balances use recorded snapshots at or before month end. Missing history makes ready-to-assign unavailable. Future months show the plan without claiming spendable cash; future assignments reserve current cash. Exact integer calculations refuse unsafe totals.

screens.label: Transactions
screens.description: Transactions supports month/account/category/search/posting/direction/review and duplicate filters, clear loaded/full matching counts, splits and confirmed atomic bulk categorization. Selection persists across filters; stale batches save nothing. Export loaded rows keeps the visible scope. Export history prepares an owned-only CSV across stored months with optional inclusive dates and account selection. It shows captured scope/count/time before download, omits notes and household mirrors, and refuses over 5,000 rows or 2 MiB without truncation. Includes useful loading, empty, failed-read and retry states; shared rows stay read only.

screens.label: Accounts
screens.description: Manual accounts offer Add transaction Reconcile and Import CSV actions. Connected banks show their names (filled in on the next sync), balances, sync status and reconnect. Latest balance totals keep currencies separate and subtract debts, with no FX conversion. Each account retains its own currency. A total outside safe precision is unavailable while individual balances remain visible.

screens.label: Getting started
screens.description: Begin with a private manual account without bank keys, enter transactions or import CSV from Accounts. Bank connection remains available after an admin configures keys. Connected accounts can build a first-budget draft from up to three months of history.

screens.label: Reports
screens.description: Reports is a primary tab with currency-separated spending, cash flow and own-account net worth; mixed currencies require a choice and no FX conversion occurs. Manual net worth reconstructs opening balances and posted ledger entries through the owner local date; connected accounts retain recorded snapshots. Sources, dated coverage, missing balances and accessible history are disclosed. Category/payee bars and monthly income/outflow open bounded exact signed contributions, including split portions, with a full count/total and changed-record disclosure. Pending spending remains included and transfers are excluded per owner. Private notes are omitted; details reload independently and Refresh reports updates aggregates. Unsafe monetary outputs are rejected.

screens.label: Finance settings
screens.description: Everything Finance can configure: How much Moss does alone (Ask about everything, Handle routine and ask about new, Run it all and review weekly, or Custom; a new install starts on Handle routine and ask about new), the Maximum per budget move dollar limit, a Customize list of per-action switches, Bank connection keys for admins, and this week's activity with an Undo button on each row and an Earlier weeks button. Freedom and dollar-limit controls stay unavailable until their reads succeed. Read failures have separate explanations and Retry; unverified fallback values are not presented as confirmed settings.
Review projected bills, match a posted transaction once, skip an occurrence, or stop future plans. Plans do not post payments.
screens.label: Upcoming bills

features.description: On Transactions, a Needs a look row has a category picker, a Confirm button and an Always for this merchant switch (off by default; on, the new category becomes a rule for that merchant). Confirm all N confirms every Needs a look row the filter and search show, keeps Moss's guessed categories, makes no rules, and disappears when none are left. When no rows remain in Needs a look, the empty state says no transactions in this view need review; the current month, search and local confirmations determine that view.

Budget totals save through awaited, reviewed host actions. Enter or Save; cancelled/stale/ambiguous saves retain input and require checking records before retry. Category targets guide monthly or dated savings without moving money. Flexible mode routes selected category activity, assignment guidance and carry into one funded pool. Changing mode requires current-month review and confirmation, no funded future plans or conflicting targets. Leaving requires explicit destinations for available money; historical policies and transaction categories stay intact. Pool members cannot be funded independently. Upcoming plans projected bills with owned posted matching, skip, undo and stop; no payments or transactions are created.

Start without bank keys through Getting started → Add a manual account. Accounts imports UTF-8 CSV into manual accounts, up to 1 MiB, 200 rows and 500 KiB of mapped entries. Explicit column, date-order and money-direction mapping precedes a read-only preview in the account currency. Rows start uncategorized. Every possible duplicate needs Skip or Import anyway. Invalid dates, sub-cent/unsafe amounts and mixed currencies prevent saving. Receipt, transactions, balance and activity commit atomically; identical replay does not duplicate rows. A changed ledger requires a fresh preview. Uncertain saves require checking saved records. No provider-account import, FX conversion or automatic duplicate deletion.

After connected or manual account history exists, Getting started builds a stored draft in the chosen budget currency. Edit amounts with Enter or Save; totals change only after persistence. Starting requires an explicit host confirmation and commits categories, assignments and draft status together. Stale reviews keep typed input for review; ambiguous outcomes require checking saved records. No bank connection is required.

Moss sorts each new transaction into a category and marks the ones it is unsure about as Needs a look. Whether Moss confirms its own guesses for merchants you have confirmed before, and for new merchants, follows the Sort purchases settings. A guessed category still counts toward the budget while it waits for review.

In chat, Moss can move money between categories, set a category's assigned total, make a merchant rule, and add, rename or archive categories. Each reports what it changed, before and after, and is logged. A move or change larger than the Maximum per budget move setting in Finance settings (default $100) asks for approval first; smaller ones follow the freedom setting.

On Finance settings, How much Moss does alone offers three steps plus Custom. Ask about everything makes Moss suggest every change. Handle routine, ask about new lets Moss sort merchants it knows and move money up to the limit, and asks about anything new. Run it all, review weekly lets Moss do everything up to the limit. Custom shows when the switches under Customize match none of the three. A step saves at once; if saving fails the choice goes back with an error. Until policy and limit reads succeed, controls are unavailable. Retry reloads failed settings without writing; a failed refresh keeps the last confirmed values.

On Finance settings, Maximum per budget move sets the dollar limit (a whole number from 0 to 100000, default 100). Moss asks for approval before any move or assigned total above it, at every step. It saves when you press Enter or click away; a bad or failed entry goes back to the saved amount with an error. Until policy and limit reads succeed, controls are unavailable. Retry reloads failed settings without writing; a failed refresh keeps the last confirmed values.

On Finance settings, Customize lists one switch per action Moss can take (sort purchases from merchants you have seen, move money between categories, sort purchases from new merchants, make merchant rules, add, rename or archive categories). On lets Moss do it alone, off makes Moss ask first. Connect a bank and Share an account show Always asks and cannot be switched.

On Finance settings, an admin sees Bank connection with the Plaid client ID and Plaid secret, each marked Saved or Not set, and a Replace button that takes a new value. Everyone else does not see this section. Saved values are never shown.

On Finance settings, the activity list shows this week's changes by you and by Moss, newest first, each with who did it and when. Undo reverses a row (a budget amount, a move between categories, a sorted purchase, a merchant rule, or a category added or archived) and says so inline if the data changed since. Earlier weeks loads the week before. With nothing yet it says Nothing yet.

Amounts use safe integer hundredths and decimal provider rounding. Invalid calendar months are rejected. Transfer inference requires the same currency. A batch of budget assignments validates every category and amount before one SQL commit; a rejected batch changes nothing.

Transactions can be filtered by account, category, pending or posted status, money in or out, uncategorized rows and possible duplicates. Possible duplicates match account, currency, amount, date and payee; they are suggestions and are never deleted automatically. Phone filters expand on request and show their active count.

Export loaded rows downloads a CSV of exactly the currently loaded filtered transactions with separate outflow and inflow columns, currency and posting state. The loaded count and total matches make truncation visible. This is not a complete account backup.

Split owned posted transactions into up to 20 non-transfer allocations totaling the exact signed amount. Saving awaits persistence and checks amount, currency and split revision. Provider corrections retain allocations for repair; unbalanced splits count once as uncategorized. One part removes a split. Select up to 200 loaded owned posted unsplit rows for one reviewed category change. Host confirmation saves all or none using captured row revisions. Amounts, accounts, dates, notes and reconciliation stay unchanged; no rule is created. Cancel retains choices; changed or uncertain saves require checking records before a new review. Shared, pending and legacy-storage rows are excluded. Older hosts explain the update required. Neither action moves bank money.

Manual cash, checking, savings, credit, loan and asset accounts need no bank credentials. Opening balance/date and a fixed two-decimal currency establish the ledger; posted entries update exact balances atomically with replay-safe identities and Moss-timezone date checks. Manual accounts remain private. Forms await committed success; uncertain saves retain input for a records check. Reconcile a dated statement by selecting cleared entries and matching its exact balance. Finish requires zero difference and a current ledger revision; receipt, entry marks and activity commit together. Completed periods reject backdated postings, while outstanding entries can clear later. Reviews above 500 entries require an earlier cutoff and cannot finish a truncated list. Old hosts or unmigrated storage require an update. Linked transfers, provider reconciliation and automatic adjustments are unavailable.

assistantOnboarding.guidance: Read before writing. Budget amounts are integer cents in one reviewed currency. Read finance.budget.status for totals, ready money, revision and fingerprint; pass its tokens on writes. Never guess category ids. In flexible mode, fund the pool with finance.flex.assign; member amounts are informational. Mode changes use finance.flex.preview then explicit confirmed finance.flex.configure, including destinations when leaving. Assignment and move confirmations bind to previous totals; changed reviews reject without automatic retry. Read drafts before editing or explicitly confirmed start. Targets and bill plans do not move money. Bill reviews match owned posted transactions once; skip, undo or stop projections explicitly. Quote returned actual amounts and before/after totals. Ambiguous responses require checking saved records before retrying. No bank transfers or payments occur.

preferences.label: Maximum per budget move
preferences.description: Moves above this amount ask first, at every freedom step.

assistantTools.name: finance.accounts.list
assistantTools.description: List own and explicitly shared accounts, currencies, current balances and bank sync status. Manual account balances come from the ledger.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.context
assistantTools.description: Read manual entry setup. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.account-create
assistantTools.description: Add a manual account. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.manual.entry-create
assistantTools.description: Add a manual transaction. Manual records only; no bank money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.reconciliation.read
assistantTools.description: Read manual account statement entries and exact balances; no financial action.

assistantTools.name: finance.reconciliation.finish
assistantTools.description: Finish an exact statement match and protect the completed period. No money is moved.

assistantTools.name: finance.import.preview
assistantTools.description: Validate rows and identify possible duplicates without saving.

assistantTools.name: finance.import.apply
assistantTools.description: Atomically import reviewed manual transactions; no bank money moves.

assistantTools.name: finance.setup.status
assistantTools.description: Report whether bank keys are set up and whether a bank is connected.

assistantTools.name: finance.connect.start
assistantTools.description: Start connecting a bank via Plaid Hosted Link; returns a link URL to open.

assistantTools.name: finance.connect.poll
assistantTools.description: Check pending bank connections and finish token exchange.

assistantTools.name: finance.sync.run-now
assistantTools.description: Sync accounts and transactions from Plaid now.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.query
assistantTools.description: Query a calendar month of transactions by account, category, payee or private notes, posting status, direction, uncategorized state, or possible duplicate. Possible duplicates remain in the ledger; no automatic deletion.

assistantTools.name: finance.transaction.split
assistantTools.description: Allocate one posted transaction across 1 to 20 categories. Signed parts must equal the original amount. Refuses stale amount, currency or revision; does not move money.

assistantTools.name: finance.transaction.categorize
assistantTools.description: Set the category of a transaction from a merchant that already has confirmed history. Refuses a new merchant; use finance.transaction.categorize-new for that.

assistantTools.name: finance.transaction.categorize-new
assistantTools.description: Set the category of a transaction from a merchant with no confirmed history yet. Refuses a merchant that has it; use finance.transaction.categorize for that.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.configure
assistantTools.description: Choose the budget's immutable working currency. Existing assignment amounts are preserved and require explicit acknowledgement. Open legacy drafts are discarded for a fresh currency-scoped build. No currency conversion occurs.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.status
assistantTools.description: Show the envelope budget for a month: to-be-budgeted, assigned, activity, and available per category.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.build
assistantTools.description: Build a first-budget draft from posted history in the selected budget currency. Does not assign money or overwrite an existing draft or budget. Returns a persisted draft outcome or explains missing history.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.get
assistantTools.description: Read the first-budget draft: its lines by group, the plan total, monthly income and the amount still unplanned. Reads only; the draft is started from the Getting started screen.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.update
assistantTools.description: Change one line of the first-budget draft: set its plan amount, rename it, move it to another group, or drop it. Read the draft first with finance.budget.draft.get for the draft id and category keys. To add a line that is not in the draft, give a new lowercase categoryKey with categoryName, groupName (Bills, Everyday, Fun or Savings) and amountCents. Returns the line and the draft total before and after; quote those numbers instead of adding them up. It cannot start the budget. Pass expectedRevision and expectedFingerprint exactly from the latest matching budget or draft read. A stale review is rejected; refresh and review again before retrying.

categoryKey.description: The line's category key from the draft, or a new lowercase slug to add a line.

amountCents.description: The monthly plan amount in integer cents (600 dollars is 60000).

dropped.description: True takes the line out of the budget.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.draft.start
assistantTools.description: Start the reviewed first budget. All planned categories, amounts, activity and draft status commit together. Use the current draft id and review tokens; changed data rejects the whole start. Requires explicit confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.assign
assistantTools.description: Set a category's assigned total for a month. Pass the total it has now as previousCents (read it from finance.budget.status); a wrong value is rejected. Returns the before and after totals. Pass expectedRevision and expectedFingerprint exactly from the latest matching budget or draft read. A stale review is rejected; refresh and review again before retrying.

categoryId.description: Id of an existing category. Never guess one; list categories first.

amountCents.description: The new assigned total in integer cents (50 dollars is 5000).

previousCents.description: The category's assigned total right now, in integer cents.

assistantTools.name: finance.budget.move
assistantTools.description: Move money between two categories for a month. Use fromCategoryId ready_to_assign to take unassigned money. Returns the before and after assigned totals. Pass expectedRevision and expectedFingerprint exactly from the latest matching budget or draft read. A stale review is rejected; refresh and review again before retrying.

fromCategoryId.description: Category to take from, or ready_to_assign for unassigned money.

toCategoryId.description: Category to give to. Must be a real category id.

amountCents.description: Amount to move, positive integer cents (50 dollars is 5000).

assistantTools.name: finance.rule.set
assistantTools.description: Always put one merchant in one category from now on. Replaces an earlier rule for that merchant and returns the before and after category.

merchant.description: The merchant name as it appears on transactions.

assistantTools.name: finance.category.upsert
assistantTools.description: Add a category (leave id out) or rename or regroup one (pass its id). Returns the before and after name and group.

id.description: Id of the category to change. Omit to add one.

groupName.description: The budget group the category sits in.

assistantTools.name: finance.category.archive
assistantTools.description: Archive a category. Refused while this month still has money assigned to it; move that money first.

id.description: Id of the category to archive.

assistantTools.name: finance.account.set-shared
assistantTools.description: Share or unshare one of your bank accounts with the household.

assistantTools.name: finance.reports.spending
assistantTools.description: Monthly spending and cash flow, including pending and household-shared transactions, with transfers excluded. Returns available currencies; mixed currencies require an explicit currency before totals are returned. No FX conversion.

assistantTools.name: finance.reports.net-worth
assistantTools.description: Daily own-account net worth from recorded balance snapshots (liabilities negated). Mixed currencies require an explicit currency before a headline is returned. Earlier balances carry forward; accounts without snapshots are omitted. No FX conversion.

assistantTools.name: finance.activity.list
assistantTools.description: List the changes Finance recorded between two times, newest first: who made each one (you or Moss), what it was in plain words, and whether it can be undone. Reads only.

from.description: Start of the window, an ISO timestamp.

to.description: End of the window, an ISO timestamp.

assistantTools.name: finance.target.set
assistantTools.description: Save or remove monthly or balance-by-date guidance from this month onward. Does not assign money. Read budget status before saving.

assistantTools.name: finance.bills.read
assistantTools.description: Review upcoming bills. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.create
assistantTools.description: Save a recurring bill. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.decide
assistantTools.description: Review a bill occurrence. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.stop
assistantTools.description: Stop a bill plan. Plans are projections; no payment or transaction is created. Writes require the current bills review.

assistantTools.name: finance.bill.clear
assistantTools.description: Return a skipped or matched occurrence to projected. Does not change the ledger.

assistantTools.name: finance.flex.preview
assistantTools.description: Review cash-backed pool routing or explicitly allocate available money when leaving. Past months and transaction categories are preserved. Mode changes require current-month review and confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.flex.configure
assistantTools.description: Review cash-backed pool routing or explicitly allocate available money when leaving. Past months and transaction categories are preserved. Mode changes require current-month review and confirmation.

assistantTools.name: finance.flex.assign
assistantTools.description: Set the total funding for the flexible pool, counted once. Pass its displayed previous total and review tokens from Budget. Member amounts remain informational guidance.

amountCents.description: The new assigned total in integer cents (50 dollars is 5000).

previousCents.description: The category's assigned total right now, in integer cents.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.bulk-category
assistantTools.description: Categorize 1 to 200 reviewed owned posted unsplit transactions atomically. A changed or unavailable selection saves nothing. Preserves amounts, dates, clearing and reconciliation; creates no rules.

assistantTools.name: finance.reports.transactions
assistantTools.description: Read the exact signed transaction contributions behind a selected report category, payee, income or outflow period. Uses the same currency, pending and per-owner transfer policy. Returns a bounded page plus full count and total; omits notes.

assistantTools.name: finance.transactions.export
assistantTools.description: Prepare a spreadsheet-safe CSV of owned transaction history across stored months. Optional inclusive dates and account filters; reads one SQL snapshot. Omits household mirrors and private notes. Refuses files above 5,000 rows or 2 MiB instead of truncating. Does not change financial data.

assistantActionFamilies.description: Decide the category the first time a merchant appears.

assistantActionFamilies.description: Always put a merchant in the same category.

assistantActionFamilies.description: Assign or move budget amounts, up to your limit.

assistantActionFamilies.description: Change the shape of your budget.

assistantActionFamilies.label: Adjust a draft budget
assistantActionFamilies.description: Change a budget that hasn't started yet.
